approved_note: The owner watches the pilot (E:\SK\krishna-pov-pilot\ep1.mp4) and then sets "approved": true here (the repo variable KRISHNA_POV=off pauses it later). Until then scripts/day-plan.mjs plans no pov slot and nothing is uploaded.
rules: STORY.md section 10. Our own 2D Krishna; one speaker talking to camera; POSITIVE messages only ('puja bhi karo, aur saath mein ... bhi karo'); never question, mock or tell people to drop a ritual or festival practice; no politics, caste/gender debates, health or astrology claims; a quote is a real Gita verse with chapter.verse, else 'in the spirit of the Gita'; Khatu Shyam ji only as the sheesh, never a speaking body. Gita Jayanti 2026 = 20 Dec (Mokshada Ekadashi; automation/festivals.json, Drik + Prokerala), not 1 Dec.
